strings.subtitle: — File destroyer —
strings.dnd_hint: (or drag a file intae this windae)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Draggin an drappin no available. Uise the button ablow.
strings.shred_button: D E S T R O Y
strings.ssd_warning:
Cawtion! On SSD, the owerscrievin method disna garantee destruction acause o TRIM.
This program is for HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
The file "{name}" will be owerscrieved an deletit.

Continue?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS alternative data straims (ADS) arna processed.
• The USN journal isna cleired.
• Shadda copies an clood syncs
  (OneDrive etc.) arna affectit.
strings.status_full: Content fully owerscrieved wi zeros. Recovery impossible — tools will see zeros anely.
strings.status_fast: Heid, tail an 4 MB stripes owerscrieved. The lave is untouched, but acause o gaps, full recovery bi consumer tools is impossible. For confidential documents, uise FULL mode.
strings.status_empty: The file wis empie, owerscrievin no needit. Deletit.
strings.error_permission: Canna access the file. It micht be open in anither program. Close it an try again.
strings.error_not_found: File no funnd. It micht awready be deletit.
strings.error_is_symlink: This is a symbolic link. Links canna be destroyed — the target file will bide hail.
strings.error_reparse: This is a placeholder file (OneDrive or similar). Its data is in the clood, no on the disk — thare's naethin tae destroy here.
strings.error_not_file: This isna a file (folder or somethin else). Drapp a file.
strings.error_hardlinks: This file haes ither haird links ({n} awthegither). Haird links hae nae primary — aw names are equal. If ye destroy throu the current peth, data will be owerscrieved an cut tae 32 bytes, but the lave will bide accessible throu ither links. Delete aw links first.
strings.error_compressed:
The file is compressed, encrypted or sparse. Owerscrievin wi zeros disna garantee destruction o auld data acause NTFS stores it differently.

Remove the attribute: richt-clack → Properties → Advanced → untick "Compress" an/or "Encrypt". Then rin SHREDDER again.
